other_accessions.GSE283234: whole-tissue eWAT/iWAT RNA-seq of HFD mice +/- AAV-irisin (DA.p1, S2.1.p3); not requested

assay: populational (1,000-cell) Smart-seq2 RNA-seq, ImmGen ULI protocol, NextSeq 500; STAR + featureCounts (S4.9.p4)
sample_inclusion: FACS-sorted IL-33(EGFP)- eWAT mSCs from 12-week-old male Il33-Egfp mice, cultured 3 days with PBS or 10 nM irisin + HSP90a; triplicate samples (S2.3.p5, S4.11.p1, FIG3 g)
sample_exclusion: QC: replicates with Pearson r < 0.9 or poor PCA congregation removed (S4.9.p4); none reported removed
primary_estimand: Transcriptional effect of 3-day irisin/HSP90a vs PBS treatment on cultured IL-33- eWAT mesenchymal stromal cells (Il33 and cytokine induction; attenuation of an adipogenesis-up signature). Irisin is an exercise-induced myokine; this dataset has no exercise arm, so the 'exercise' question is answered only through this myokine (exercise-mimetic) treatment.

blocking_or_covariance.note: two independent culture arms; no subject/donor key

matrix_scale: raw featureCounts read counts (GEO data_processing; S4.9.p4)
paper_method: DESeq2 median-of-ratios normalisation, genes <15 reads or CV>0.30 removed, comparison in Multiplot Studio (GenePattern); test not named (S4.9.p4, GEO data_processing)

reported_findings.n_deg: not_reported in text (volcano plot FIG3 g only)
reported_findings.up: Il33 ~10-fold up; Il6, Fgf23, Ccl2, Ccl7, Cxcl5 up (S2.3.p5)
reported_findings.down: 147 of 195 adipogenesis-up signature genes attenuated (75%), incl. Fabp4, Adipoq, Cd36, Pparg (S2.3.p5)
reported_findings.signature_test: chi-squared test for signature enrichment (S4.19.p1); signature 'came from gene-set enrichment analysis' (S4.9.p4)

whole_tissue_rule_not_applicable: S4.9.p3 (DESeq2 BH padj <= 0.05 & |log2FC| >= 1) describes the adipose-tissue dataset GSE283234
